item.title: PD City Council Votes Rejects Ending Recognition of Pride Month
item.description: The Palm Desert City Council voted 4-1 Tuesday to reject Councilman Joe Pradetto’s proposal for the city to stop recognizing Pride Month. Mayor Evan Trubee and Councilmembers Karina Quintanilla, Gina Nestande and Jan Harnik voted against Pradetto’s proposal Tuesday at City Hall.
